sentences.en: In this courtyard, besides the buildings already mentioned, are the oldest parts of the castle, the so-called Alte Bau (old building) and the Bandhaus.

sentences.en: Opposite is the Neu Bau, begun in 1588, in which are the government offices and the law courts.
